title: Unsupported Microsoft SQL Server on a production virtual machine

case_origin.source: Tenable vulnerability export supplied for thesis experiment

source_references.plugin_name: Microsoft SQL Server Unsupported Version Detection (remote check)

experimental_selection_reason: Critical unsupported database software finding; selected to represent technology obsolescence and lifecycle risk rather than a single CVE.

finding.plugin_name: Microsoft SQL Server Unsupported Version Detection (remote check)
finding.synopsis: An unsupported version of a database server is running on the remote host.
finding.description:
According to its self-reported version number, the installation of Microsoft SQL Server on the remote host is no longer supported.

Lack of support implies that no new security patches for the product will be released by the vendor. As a result, it is likely to contain security vulnerabilities.
finding.recommended_remediation: Upgrade to a version of Microsoft SQL Server that is currently supported.
